title: ADAPTIVE GENERATION OF BIAS-ELICITING QUESTIONS FOR LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating open-ended counterfactual questions using explicit placeholders (male/female) or implicit name substitutions, and evaluating the LLM responses using an LLM judge for differential treatment, tone disparities, and stereotyping.

Generating open-ended counterfactual questions using explicit placeholders (White/Black/Asian/Hispanic) or typical associated names, and comparing LLM responses via an LLM judge to detect stereotyping, language assumptions, and differential assistance.

Generating open-ended counterfactual questions using explicit placeholders (Christian/Muslim/Hindu/Jewish) or associated names, and using an LLM judge to evaluate responses for unrequested religious markers, observance assumptions, and disparate accommodations.
